text: The current Chief Development Officer, CreateTO intends to retire in the second quarter of 2023. The Chief Executive Officer will provide a verbal update on the status of the search for a new Chief Development Officer. Part of the update will be provided in closed session as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the report (April 6, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for information.
